name: symbols-count
notes: Synthetic E-sheet at 1/8" = 1'-0": 9 duplex receptacles and 6 light fixtures in the plan, one of each in the legend (not counted). Boxes are page fractions from crates/takeoff-agent/src/eval/synth.rs.

every light fixture symbol (a small square with an X in it)
